text: Completed versioned renderer-neutral scene serialization. Revision-1 document stores external URI+SHA-256 references, exact mesh/topology and layer identities, full viewer state, backend-neutral feature requirements, and sorted provenance without embedding geometry or vertex payloads. Canonical JSON codec has strict duplicate/unknown-field handling plus explicit Ignore policy; unsupported revisions remain typed errors. Restore validates resolved references and model identity before reducer replay. JVM and Scala.js each pass 41/41 surface-view tests, including byte-identical encode/decode/encode, bilateral camera and semantic resource reproduction, malformed JSON, future fields/revisions, digest/topology mismatch, and capability admission. Documentation added to the surface viewer conformance record.
